newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Malaysian firm to build $68 mln resort in Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian firm to build $68 mln resort in Vietnam.

text.p: Vietnam has approved a venture between Malaysia's Goh Hock Guan and the Quang Ninh Import-Export Company to build a $68 million tourist complex near Halong Bay, an official of the local company partner said on Thursday.
He said the joint venture, Halong Bay Intour, will be 60 percent-owned by Goh Hock Guan and 40 percent-owned by Quang Ninh Import-Export.
The first stage of the hotel and entertainment complex is expected to be up and running by 1998.
Halong Bay, with its 3,000 islands dotted around the emerald waters of the Gulf of Tonkin, is one of Vietnam's top tourist attractions.
